Description Generates and/or adjust the unique names of component prototypes and MCD display data in the scope of a single ECU. This information is kept in the so-called ECU Flat Map. The names can be generated according to some rules (e.g. from model elements of the VFB system), taken over from the System Flat Map, from partial Flat Maps, or be manually defined. The task shall always result in an ECU Flat Map with unique names. Relation Type Related Element Mul.
